cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.18.0 FATAL_ERROR)
project(CsHello)

include(GNUInstallDirs)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

find_package(CopperSpice REQUIRED)

# generated by uic (ui_hello.h) and rcc (qrc_resources.cpp)
COPPERSPICE_RESOURCES(
   ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/hello.ui
   ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/resources.qrc
)

add_executable(cs-hello
   ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/main.cpp
   ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/hello.ui
   ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/resources.qrc
   ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/qrc_resources.cpp
)

target_include_directories(cs-hello PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR})

target_link_libraries(cs-hello
   CopperSpice::CsCore
   CopperSpice::CsGui
)

install(TARGETS cs-hello DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR})
